name: meleeflag-base
description: Control: a new melee map nothing is added to; the World Editor's save keeps the Melee flag (w3i flags 0x4)

name: meleeflag-unit
description: (a) a custom unit (a w3u entry): the World Editor's save and Studio's take the Melee flag off

name: meleeflag-unit-removed
description: (b) a custom unit made and deleted again, so the w3u holds no entry (or is gone): the flag stays

name: meleeflag-trigger-added
description: (c1) a custom trigger next to the unchanged Melee Initialization

args.name: Custom One
args.script:
function Trig_Custom_One_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
endfunction

function InitTrig_Custom_One takes nothing returns nothing
    set gg_trg_Custom_One = CreateTrigger()
    call TriggerAddAction(gg_trg_Custom_One, function Trig_Custom_One_Actions)
endfunction

name: meleeflag-category-off
description: flat.w3x with the trigger category Initialization renamed Setup and the Melee flag cleared (0x9c10): the save turns it back on (branch we-batch-3; c4 measured only keeping it on). Input: tests/fixtures/we-specs/make-melee-valid.mjs category-off. A Studio-made input can't hold the flag off: its pack puts Melee back.

steps.eval: const p = 'map/war3map.wtg.json'; let t = await w3.workspace.readText(p); if (!t.includes("\"name\":\"Initialization\"")) throw new Error('no ' + "\"name\":\"Initialization\""); await w3.workspace.writeText(p, t.replace("\"name\":\"Initialization\"", "\"name\":\"Setup\""));

name: meleeflag-trigger-initoff
description: (c5) Melee Initialization with Initially On off

steps.eval: const p = 'map/war3map.wtg.json'; let t = await w3.workspace.readText(p); if (!t.includes("\"initiallyOff\": false")) throw new Error('no ' + "\"initiallyOff\": false"); await w3.workspace.writeText(p, t.replace("\"initiallyOff\": false", "\"initiallyOff\": true"));

name: meleeflag-trigger-runoninit

steps.eval: const p = 'map/war3map.wtg.json'; let t = await w3.workspace.readText(p); if (!t.includes("\"runOnInit\": false")) throw new Error('no ' + "\"runOnInit\": false"); await w3.workspace.writeText(p, t.replace("\"runOnInit\": false", "\"runOnInit\": true"));

name: meleeflag-trigger-action
description: (c8) one melee action replaced by another

steps.eval: const p = 'map/war3map.wtg.json'; let t = await w3.workspace.readText(p); if (!t.includes("\"name\": \"MeleeGrantHeroItems\"")) throw new Error('no ' + "\"name\": \"MeleeGrantHeroItems\""); await w3.workspace.writeText(p, t.replace("\"name\": \"MeleeGrantHeroItems\"", "\"name\": \"MeleeStartingHeroLimit\""));

name: meleeflag-trigger-description

steps.eval: const p = 'map/war3map.wtg.json'; let t = await w3.workspace.readText(p); if (!t.includes("\"description\": \"Default melee game initialization for all players\"")) throw new Error('no ' + "\"description\": \"Default melee game initialization for all players\""); await w3.workspace.writeText(p, t.replace("\"description\": \"Default melee game initialization for all players\"", "\"description\": \"Mine\""));

name: meleeflag-header
